title: Page options button is covered by the page tab strip
description: With four or more page tabs the selected tab slides over the Page options (...) button in the chat side panel, on desktop and on a phone. A click or tap on the dots lands on the tab, so Share, Sources, Rename, Refresh and Delete cannot be reached by pointer; only the keyboard works.
suggested_fix: Reserve space for the button, let the tab row scroll on its own, or move Page options out of the tab row.

title: HTML page stays on "Loading"
description: The Cash HTML page often never leaves its own "Loading" text, in the side panel and on the full-width route, even though the data call returns. About half of the loads worked. Data appeared only after the Cash page sources were refreshed.
suggested_fix: Show a timeout and error state in the frame; fix the first-load handshake.

title: Spend chart x axis shows raw ISO timestamps that overlap; y axis is clipped; no title or axis names
description: X labels overlap into an unreadable smear at every width (and spill outside the card at 390 px). Y labels are cut off on the left (34,000 shows as 4,000). The chart has no title, axis titles are raw field names, and amounts have no $ sign.
suggested_fix: Format dates, thin ticks, add left padding, title the chart and format amounts.

title: Removing the only source of a page destroys its blocks
description: Removing the only source on Spend turns the number block and the history chart into "Source not found"; the chart loses its title and axes. The confirm dialog does not say what will break.
suggested_fix: Name the blocks that depend on the source in the confirm dialog; keep block titles on orphaned blocks.

title: Share silently replaces the existing live link
description: Opening Share on a page that already has a live link creates a new link and kills the old one. The dialog looks the same for first share, replace and stop; the owner cannot see or reuse the current link. Earlier recipients lose access without warning, and a wrong-tab share is easy.
suggested_fix: Show the existing link and its age first; make "New link" an explicit action that warns about the old one.

title: Sidebar page list does not follow create, rename and delete
description: A deleted page keeps its sidebar row; clicking it silently opens an unrelated chat. A new page is missing from the sidebar and the "Show in sidebar" list until reload, and renamed pages keep the old name until reload (side panel and full-width route).
suggested_fix: Invalidate the sidebar page query after page create, rename and delete.

title: Source path that resolves to nothing shows "No data yet" while Sources says ok
description: Residual defect after discounting the seed (the seeded sources point at JSON paths the demo finance_overview result lacks, which is a seed artifact). When a block path resolves to nothing, the block drops its old value to "No data yet", Sources still shows the source as ok, and the shared snapshot is empty too. A broken path is hidden, and a manual Refresh or Retry removes numbers the user had. Original severity was critical (F-013-1, F-016-1); downgraded.
suggested_fix: Flag a block whose path found nothing (warning dot, "Path not found") and keep the last good value.

title: After Resume, the badge still says "failed" with the old paused text
description: Right after Resume the row badge goes red "failed" and "Paused after 5 failed refreshes" stays, so it looks as if resume failed. Also seen on the whole page after resume in the review story.
suggested_fix: Clear the failure text on resume and show "resuming" or "ok".

title: Sources dialog names sources by internal ids, not block titles
description: Rows read cash, vendors, stale, paused, pausedempty, outside, spend while the page shows Monthly burn, Largest vendors, Cash (stale) and so on. Each row also repeats the internal "finance_overview - Hourly".
suggested_fix: Show block titles (or a label field) as the primary row text.

title: Delete block is one click, with no confirmation or undo, and is hover-only
description: The X is invisible without hover, so touch users cannot find it, yet a tap reveals it under the thumb; keyboard focus reveals it silently; Cmd+Z did not restore the block.
suggested_fix: Add Undo toast, always-visible overflow menu on touch, focus ring on cards.

title: Failed, paused and pending blocks share one amber dot
description: Only the hover label or popover tells "I paused this" from "this is broken".
suggested_fix: Use different icons or colours for paused and failed.

title: Status popovers cover the block value and Delete button
description: The dot popover opens over the number it explains, on desktop and phone.
suggested_fix: Anchor the popover above or to the side of the value.

title: Status popovers give no next step
description: Failed: only "Request timed out" and Retry (not saying Retry refreshes the whole page). Paused: no way to resume. Paused by the user: empty popover.
suggested_fix: Add the action (Resume in Sources) and a one-line reason to each popover.

title: "Waiting for approval" lands in the chat with the card off screen
description: The link opens the Finance chat but not at the approval card, which hides behind the composer or a "new messages" pill, while the side panel still shows the page.
suggested_fix: Scroll to and highlight the approval card.

title: Pending source row in Sources has no route to its approval card
description: Menu has only Remove and Change schedule.
suggested_fix: Add "Review request" to the row menu.

title: HTML page ignores Hide amounts
description: Blocks pages and the header chip are masked; the HTML page still shows its numbers, and nothing says so.
suggested_fix: Document the limit in the page tool, or mask known amounts via the frame bridge.

title: No freshness or failure cue on HTML pages
description: No dot, Retry or time on the page; the owner must open Sources, and a Refresh gives no visible sign.
suggested_fix: Show the same fetched-time and status chip as blocks pages.

title: HTML page frame is a white slab in dark mode
description: The frame does not follow the app theme, has no border, and flashes white "Loading" on tab switch. A shared Spend chart is also a white picture in a dark card (F-057-2).
suggested_fix: Pass theme to the frame and give it a border or inset.

title: Chart warning triangle has no accessible name or explanation
description: Amber triangle on the Spend chart is not focusable and cannot be clicked, unlike the dots on other blocks.
suggested_fix: Make it a button with the same popover as other status dots.

title: Conflict banner "Page changed. Reload" hides the cost
description: It does not say that Reload discards typing, and typing stops being saved while it shows.
suggested_fix: Say what Reload discards; offer copy-out.

title: A bot with no pages gives no hint how to get one
description: No Page button, Add page row or empty state; only asking in chat creates one.
suggested_fix: Empty state: "Ask Finance to build a page".

title: Delete page confirm does not say what is lost
description: "Delete Board prep?" does not mention permanence, revisions or share links.
suggested_fix: State consequences in the dialog.

title: Page options menu puts Share first
description: Pressing Enter on the opened menu creates a public link with no confirmation; rename was also unreliable.
suggested_fix: Put Rename first; confirm before creating a link.

title: Dead share link page is bare and does not recover on hash change
description: "This link is not available." is a tiny grey line with no reason or next step; revoked and replaced links look identical; pasting a valid link into the same tab (only #token changes) still shows the error until reload.
suggested_fix: Add reason and next step; react to hashchange.

title: Hide amounts gives no indication on the page
description: Nothing says amounts are masked or how to turn it off (control is in the account menu only).
suggested_fix: Small "Amounts hidden" chip with a toggle.

title: Phone drawer starts with Pages collapsed
description: Cash takes 3 taps (menu, expand, Cash) instead of 2.
suggested_fix: Expand Pages by default when a page is the current route.

title: Sources rows truncate schedule text on a phone
description: The new schedule after Change schedule cannot be read ("finance_overview - E...").
suggested_fix: Stack the detail line under the title.

title: Drawer hides the agent that needs approval behind "+11 more"
description: With Pages expanded the agent and unread marker are not visible.

title: Landscape phone leaves ~130 px for chat
description: Header and chips use ~180 of 390 px; the approval card is clipped.

title: Markdown table styled unlike the live table card
description: Heavy grid borders and centred headers vs light rows and muted headers.

title: Icon-only controls and small touch targets
description: Page/List/Routines glyph buttons, 24-34 px targets, 20 px "Waiting for approval" link.

title: Panel forgets the tab and the tab row scrolls away
description: Close/reopen or Back resets to the first tab; panel opens on the wrong page for an approval; tab row not sticky.

title: Sidebar rows and menus are hard to tell apart
description: Identical teal avatars for the three pages, partial collapse of Pages, two controls named Page options, Show in sidebar list includes bot pages.

title: Menu items wrap to two lines
description: "Change schedule", "Remove from sidebar".

title: Stop sharing gives no feedback
description: Dialogs close and nothing else changes.

title: Stop-sharing confirm opens over the Share dialog
description: Ghost buttons show through.

title: Share dialog link field scrolled to the end; host 127.0.0.1 vs localhost
description: Only the last 30 characters show; expiry has no date.

title: Shared HTML page has default margin, no card and no snapshot time; stale blocks look healthy in the snapshot
Approval card wording differs from the spec
description: "Answered: Approve" vs "Allow"; card names host twice and not the block it unlocks; Inbox card reuses Allow / Not now.

title: "Waiting for approval" looks like muted text
description: Underlined link on the full page, plain text in the panel.

title: Rename edge cases
description: Duplicate-name error replaces the title and clears only on Escape; tapping away discards the typed title silently.

title: New page is blank and gives no saved indicator
description: No placeholder, no saving/saved cue.

title: Refresh gives no visible confirmation
description: Busy state under a second; no toast.

title: Block fetch time is hover-only and undated
description: Older fetches show "Oct 30" with no time; hover shows a bare clock time.

title: Block accessible name runs label, time and value together
description: "Monthly burn8:12 AM$86,000".

title: Layout jump when masking; numeric column left-aligned
description: Total column moves ~90 px.

title: HTML frame has fixed ~589 px height
description: Empty white below content.

title: Catalog mismatch: tab order and header gear
description: Tabs are Cash, Cash HTML, Spend; a settings gear sits in the panel header.

title: Menu needed two clicks after closing a popover with Escape
Pending block shows the refreshing shimmer
description: Block that was never fetched shimmers during page refresh.

title: Once, resizing 1280 to 390 gave a blank page (not reproducible)
description: Unconfirmed.

title: Block names carry state text as well as a dot
description: "Cash (stale)", "Payroll (paused)" (seed naming).

title: Chat header cash chip and Cash page show different numbers
description: Possibly seed data.
